title: Sheffield Edwards gives the green light at the Fontainebleau Hotel

plain: In 1960, at a meeting at the Fontainebleau Hotel in Miami, a man going by the code name "Mr. Ed" is said to have arrived and given the go-ahead, and he was Sheffield Edwards. The lawyer Dan Sheehan tells it second-hand, naming as the others involved Bob Maheu and the crime figures Santo Trafficante Jr., Johnny Roselli and Sam Giancana. He tells it as part of a wider story about secret government dealings tied to President Kennedy's killing.
